description: Returns all commodity symbols supported by CommodityPriceAPI, including category, default currency, and unit. Use this to look up a symbol before calling rate tools. Precious metals use ISO 4217 codes (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD); copper is XCU. Dated futures contracts (e.g. WTIOIL-FUT-DEC26, the December 2026 WTI contract) are listed as their own symbols with 'contract', 'deliveryMonth', 'expiresAt' and 'underlying' (the continuous parent such as WTIOIL-FUT); expired contracts are hidden unless includeExpired is set. Pass 'underlying' to list one parent's live months. A contract's latest price comes from get_latest_rates and its daily open/high/low/close (close = the exchange settlement) from get_historical_rates / get_time_series.

contract.description: Only symbols of this contract kind.

includeExpired.description: Also list expired futures contracts (hidden by default).

underlying.description: Only the dated futures contracts of this continuous parent symbol, e.g. 'WTIOIL-FUT'.

name: list_symbols
title: List supported commodity symbols
